cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine prepare this week's supplier payments for HANGS Construction.
First it reads the unpaid bills and the cash on hand.
It sets aside payroll and a minimum balance first.
Next it picks the bills due before the next run, plus a few paid early for a discount.
Then it checks each bill against every open bill and every payment since July.
A duplicate bill of $14,615 stays out of the run.
Then it checks every vendor's W-9 and bank details.
Then the holds: a disputed invoice, another company's bill, an unverified bank change, and a missing lien waiver.
A lien waiver is a subcontractor's release of claims.
The proposed batch is about $136,000, well within the cash available.
All done. Eleven bills in seven payments are ready for approval, four are held back, and a duplicate was stopped. Nothing was paid; the controller and the CFO approve before anything is released.
Jumping to the results. A person still reviews every item before anything is posted, paid or sent.
